notes.title: Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.58
notes.content:
Version 0.9.58 arrived, and with it we brought small daily improvements, with that some small errors that we noticed or the community indicates to us, have been fixed, see some below:

[b]- Fixed a critical bug that didn't save after Medium Mode Phase 22![/b]
- Continuing on the error mentioned above, to help those affected by the error, we added a temporary button in medium mode that unlocks all stages of the game (including bosses)
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1811013700395293290/857A1CEEF4432F21842664B9E8A119F67086A481/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23&imletterbox=false
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1811013700395299222/A87D8A9E4CBD5C4077B1648F2DFE9DC19427D453/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%2300000000

- Fixed bug of chains buggy in phase 28
- Minor image errors fixed

-----
Remembering that Key: Maze of Illusions has daily updates, so if you find an error, let us know before you criticize and rate the game poorly, as we will try to fix it as soon as possible! There's only one person who fixes bugs in the game (US), so it's extremely difficult to find all the bugs, so your help is very important to find the bugs and fix them.

Having said that, I also recommend you do the tutorial and start the game for the easy difficulty, the game is a precision platform masocore, no shame to start with the easy one to get the hang of the game, anyway, thank you all for playing and give your opinions, it helps a lot in the development and improvement of the Key :) ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.56 - New mode + Reduced price
notes.content:
Did you want news? So check it out 😎👇

[b]- New mode! (Nightmare Mode) - A mode made for real gamers, where it separates the men from the boys[/b]

- XBOX controller fix - Fixed not jumping after 2nd Boss bug

- Basic hitbox improvements (will have more improvements in the next updates)

- Removal of Steam demo (This has to do with the reason below)

[b]- Game price reduction (From R$14.99 to R$6.99)[/b]

- Reduced difficulty of easy mode

- We are working on temporary modes for Key!

And don't think that's all there is, there's more to it, do you want to find out which ones? Buy the game and discover there's more to come 😎👌

_____

We have already started the development of the next update and we hope to bring great news in it too, so stay tuned as we always announce our next steps on social media 👍

notes.title: Key: Maze of Illusions - XBOX UPDATE (0.9.52)
notes.content:
We've been working on improvements for Key: Maze of Illusions this holiday season, and today we have some great news for you!

Some of the changes we've had are:

[list]
[*] [b]It's finally possible to play with your XBOX controller (One / Series X/S) directly on the Key!!![/b] The option is now available in the game's controls selection, so friends who like Xbox, it took a while but it arrived ːsteamthumbsupː

[*] However, Xbox was not the only one with new features... [b]We corrected some buttons on the Playstation 4 controller, seeking to make it compatible with both the Japanese model[/b] (O instead of X), [b]and the Western model[/b] (X default), [b]and especially with parallel controls!
[/b]
[*] [b]Added the option to select the light intensity that the player thinks is best![/b] There were some comments about the game being too dark (this is the objective of the game, to pass the theme of a dungeon). However, as we know that not everyone may like this, we added an option where [b]the player can decide whether to make the game lighter or darker[/b], expanding and improving the options for the player to feel the best possible during gameplay.
 
[*] [b]We fixed minor bugs that hindered the experience during gameplay[/b], seeking to make the Key as polished as possible for you player.

[*] There were other changes, but we will not mention them in this update post because they are small things, we always intend to bring the most important and urgent news here.
[/list]

______________

- We have already started the development of version 0.9.53, we will seek to improve the game more and more and we count on you for this, any error can let us know on our social networks that we will correct it as soon as possible! :)

- Fabio Garcia
- Developer of Key: Maze of Illusions

notes.title: Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.51
notes.content:
[h2]Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.51[/h2]

Changed tutorial button location, now button is more visible!

Changed location of some instructions in tutorials

The spawn times for some enemies between stages 1-10 have been increased, making it a little friendlier for new players!

Added instructions between stages 1-6 in easy mode, helping new players!

_________

We are working to improve and fix it by making it more fun and well done for everyone! Any errors you find, you can send us and we will correct them as soon as possible! :)

- Fabio Garcia, Dev of Key: Maze of Illusions.

notes.title: Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.5
notes.content:
[h2]Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.5[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs in level 5 of Team mode (multiplayer)
[*]
[*] Removed Xbox controller from selection menu! We're sorry for that, but we've chosen to make this option unavailable until we can fix all Xbox controller related bugs! We are working on it and are looking to fix this issue as soon as possible.
[*]

[/list]

Good game everyone, any bugs can let me know that I will fix it as soon as I can! :)

notes.title: Update Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.49
notes.content:
[h2][b]Key: Maze of Illusions 0.9.49[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed lava disappearing bug in phase 20 (on 3 difficulties).
[*] Fixed not saving after stage 17 in medium mode.
[*] Added arrow indicating phase 3 and 5 jump (now you can know where to jump).
[/list]



________________ [b]Notices [/b]________________

- The function of holding on to the wall is just to make it easier, sometimes it's normal to be able to jump or not, it's not a mistake in the game, the objective is to help but not always!

- We will do daily updates as soon as we notice or are notified of an error! After 1.0 we will only notify changes on weekends, however bug fixes will remain daily.

- We are working to improve the game and make it even more fun and complete, we ask for your understanding and a vote of confidence from everyone! :)



- Fabio Garcia, Dev of Key: Maze of Illusions
